meta.name: account-based-marketing
meta.description: Concentrates marketing and sales effort on a named set of accounts rather than on volume — qualifying whether the model fits your economics at all, building the account list and the buying group inside each, tiering effort against account value, coordinating so the account experiences one campaign rather than several, and measuring account progression instead of leads. Use this to decide whether to run an account-based program, build one, or work out why an existing one produces activity and no pipeline.

copy.tagline: 聚焦高价值客户名单,按价值分层推进营销与销售
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你们做B2B营销,想集中资源攻克重点客户而非广撒网
copy.tagline_en: Run account-based marketing by targeting named accounts and measuring progression
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're in B2B marketing/sales and want to focus resources on a named set of high-value accounts

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会照此技能为你把关账号营销（ABM）的取舍：先核算每客户成本能否被大订单覆盖，再帮你列出目标客户、画出采购小组，按价值定投入层级，协调销售与营销节奏，最后用账户进展而非线索量来衡量。
howto.when: 当你想评估要不要做 ABM、想从零搭建一套基于目标账户的营销，或想排查现有 ABM 为何只有活动却带不来商机时，Claude 会调用此技能。

say.text: 帮我判断一下，我们这类业务适不适合用 ABM？
say.note: Claude 会先做经济核算，给出是否适合的结论和条件。

say.text: 请帮我梳理一份目标客户名单的筛选标准。
say.note: Claude 会引导你从契合度和证据来筛选。

say.text: 我的 ABM 一个季度只有活动，没有流水，问题可能在哪？
say.note: Claude 会带你对照成本、名单、覆盖和衡量方式找断点。

howto.what_en: Claude uses this skill to guide ABM: it checks whether per-account cost is justified by deal size, helps build target account lists and map buying groups, tiers effort by account value, aligns sales/marketing cadence, and measures account progression rather than leads.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask whether to run an account-based program, want to build one, or need to troubleshoot why an existing one produces activity but no pipeline.

say_en.text: Help me decide if our business is a fit for ABM?
say_en.note: Claude runs the economics and gives a go/no-go with conditions.

say_en.text: Please help me draft criteria for a target account list.
say_en.note: Claude guides you on fit and observable evidence.

say_en.text: My ABM has activity but no pipeline after a quarter; what could be wrong?
say_en.note: Claude checks list acceptance, coverage, and measurement.
